comment: End-to-end ground truth for the left-edge system-split fix (cue A,
three publishers, where the wide connectivity window MERGES two stacked
systems and only the narrow left-edge barline scan recovers the break.
Every number below was read off the page by eye (system count from the
left brackets, measure count from the printed barlines, verified against
a barline overlay at 600 dpi) on 2026-09-01. The schubert sys-0 count is
15, not the 14 a first 110-dpi thumbnail count gave — recount before
SCORES ONLY — do not add Nottebohm or other mixed text/music sources.

eroica-p36.notes: Litolff 1870, printed p.141 (mvt 2). The over-merge cue A discovered during Phase 1 (fix/PHASE1_RESULTS.md): bridging ink between the systems fakes a connection. Merged, the page reads as one 22-staff system of 6-10 measures.

schubert8-p23.notes: Breitkopf & Härtel parts edition, printed p.20. Sweep fix [28] -> [14, 14]. At 300 dpi one sys-0 barline is missed (14 measures); 600 dpi reads all 15.

b9-p60.notes: Litolff 1870, printed p.124 (mvt 2). One of the three known GT over-merge failures (FIX_PLAN.md: bridging 324 at the true break). System 2's strings are V1/V2/Va/Bassi — the Bassi share one staff, so 12 staves, not 13.
